text: Submission blocks injection ring submitter full: back-pressure per-submitter. .timeout expiry, submission raises mizu_error_submit_timeout instead stalling. result arrives within timeout, collection returns mizu_timeout sentinel (class c("mizu_timeout", "mizu_sentinel")). Collecting task whose handle cancelled (whose pool stopped) raises mizu_error_cancelled. Collecting task whose executing worker died raises mizu_error_worker_died, carrying slot pid worker (see mizu_error). Worker death detected OS notification latency: kernel-released lock verdict, heartbeats polling. death fails exactly tasks dead worker claimed, surviving workers consume work still queued deque.
